jobs.description: TUD Dresden University of Technology, as a University of Excellence, is one of the leading and most dynamic research institutions in the country. For TUD diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.The Dresden Center for Nanoanalysis (DCN) offers a position asResearch Associate (m/f/x) (subject to personal qualification, employees are remunerated according to salary group E 13 TV-L)starting March 1, 2027 or as soon as possible. The position comprises 75% of the fulltime weekly hours and is limited to a period of 36 months**.** The period of employment is governed by the Fixed Term Research Contracts Act (Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz - WissZeitVG). The position offers the chance to obtain further academic qualification (usually PhD).Altermagnets are a new class of magnetic materials, and their properties depend strongly on crystal structure. This project studies how atomic defects and strain affect the formation of magnetic domains and domain walls in altermagnetic single crystals such as MnTe and Fe2O3. The work combines advanced electron microscopy with magnetic imaging techniques. Within the SPP 2558 “Unconventional Magnetism: Beyond the S-Wave Magnetism Paradigm” and in strong collaboration with the group of Prof. Claire Donnelly (ETH Zürich), the successful candidate will help build a comprehensive picture of how structure and magnetism interact across different length. Tasks: - acquire and analyze aberration-corrected HR-(S)TEM images and determine local chemical compositions using EDS and EELS- perform large-field-of-view strain measurements with 4D-STEM and correlate strain and defect maps with XMCD imaging- develop and apply STEM-EMCD and vortex-EMCD techniques and apply them to altermagnets- collaborate with a PhD student of Prof. Claire Donnelly (Co-PI, responsible for XMCD)- publish and present results in peer-reviewed journals and at (inter)national conferencesRequirements: - a very good university degree (e. g. Master) in physics (preferred), materials science, nanotechnology, or a related field- a profound background in solid state physics in general, and of crystal structures, crystalline defects, magnetism and the mechanics of materials, including stress, strain, and deformation in particular- experience with transmission electron microscopy or another advanced characterization method- strong analytical and quantitative skills, and an interest in computational data analysis (e.g., Python)- good written and spoken EnglishDesirable:- experience with electron microscopy of magnetic materials, EMCD, or electron holography- familiarity with magnetism, particularly antiferromagnetism or altermagnetism- experience with electron-diffraction-based strain analysis- interest in simulation of electron scatteringWe offer: - access to aberration-corrected TEM and advanced electron microscopy facilities- supervision and training in state-of-the-art techniques- the opportunity for engaging and independent work within a flat hierarchy, in an open-minded team and supportive atmosphere- flexible arrangements for work hours to support a good work-life balance- 30 days of vacation per year (based on a 5-day workweek)- extensive opportunities for professional development and continuing education- health care and sports programs offered by TUD- a discounted job ticket (also available as a Deutschlandticket)- participation in the supplementary pension scheme for employees in the public sector via VBL (Federal and State Government Employees Retirement Fund)TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage women to apply. The university is a family-friendly university. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. If multiple candidates prove to be equally qualified, those with disabilities or with equivalent status pursuant to the German Social Code IX (SGB IX) will receive priority for employment.Application:Please submit your detailed application with the usual documents by January 4, 2027 (stamped arrival date of the university central mail service or the time stamp on the email server of TUD applies), preferably via the TUD SecureMail Portal https://securemail.tu-dresden.de (https://securemail.tu-dresden.de) by sending it as a single pdf file to recruiting-dcn@tu-dresden.de (https://mailto:recruiting-dcn@tu-dresden.de) or to:TU Dresden, Dresden Center for Nanoanalysis, Dr. Darius Pohl,Helmholtzstr. 10, 01069 Dresden, Germany.Please submit copies only, as your application will not be returned to you. Expenses incurred in attending interviews cannot be reimbursed.TUD is a founding partner in the DRESDEN-concept alliance.Reference to data protection: Your data protection rights, the purpose for which your data will be processed, as well as further information about data protection is available to you on the website:https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis (https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis) .Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Analyse, Entwicklung, Festkörperphysik, Nanotechnologie, Physik, Materialwissenschaft, Präsentation

JOIN OUR TEAM IN BONN FOR A FULL-TIME UNLIMITED POSITION AS SENIOR PROGRAM MANAGER FINANCE SYSTEMS TRANSFORMATION (F/M/X)Finance Systems Transformation is responsible for running SHAPE+, a DHL Group cross-divisional Finance transformation program. SHAPE+ aims at driving standardization and automation of core Accounting and Cost Accounting processes across Business Units and its consolidation into ONE SAP S/4 HANA Finance ERP platform. This significantly increases the efficiency and effectiveness of our Finance set-up and is the basis for the continuous transformation and digitalization of the DHL Group Finance organization.Within the SHAPE+ organization, the Program, Deployment & Change Management workstream is responsible for the central program management of the transformation program, the overall deployment management of the platform, the definition and governance of the project methodology, training, and enablement of the teams as well as the overall change management and communication. It is complemented by the teams of Process Standards & Governance, Platform & Digitalization as well as Data Migration & Test Management.Are you ready to shape the management agenda of one of DHL Group’s most important Finance transformation programs and turn strategic priorities into measurable execution?As Senior Program Manager, you will drive high-priority program initiatives across SHAPE+, prepare decision-ready C-level management presentations such as Steering Committees, and translate complex program information into clear recommendations, actions, and follow-ups. You will lead continuous improvement projects, strengthen program management standards, and integrate automation and AI solutions into everyday ways of working to increase transparency, efficiency, and delivery quality across the Finance transformation program.   Your tasks* Act as a senior advisor to Program and Senior Management, translating strategic priorities into focused action and constructively challenging where direction, decisions, or escalation are required.* Bring a simplification and automation mindset to program management, identifying where ways of working, tools, reporting, and decision processes can be made more efficient, transparent, and impact-oriented.* Oversee program financial management: budget tracking, business case monitoring, funding approvals, resource/capacity planning, and cost transparency.* Provide senior-level insight on program performance, risks, financials, resources, and delivery status, turning complex input into clear options, recommendations, and management actions.* Challenge and improve program standards, governance routines, and reporting mechanisms to increase quality, consistency, and decision readiness across the program.* Shape and drive executive governance forums such as Steering Committees, leadership meetings, and decision boards: define agendas, consolidate content, challenge inputs, document decisions, and ensure follow-up — including agenda planning for related management events (offsites, Team Days, program reviews).* Lead program status management: consolidate progress updates, maintain program-level escalations, and provide transparent reporting to Senior Management and key stakeholders.* Own improvement initiatives across Program Management standards, tools, and ways of working — within workstreams and across the program.* Guide and develop Program Management team members, fostering skill growth and consistent application of program management standards across the PMO.   Your profile* Minimum five years of program or project management experience in large-scale transformation programs involving multiple workstreams and stakeholder groups; preferred in IT, Finance ERP* Proven ability to prepare senior management and C-level presentations, including Steering Committee materials, decision papers, executive briefings, and concise management storylines.* Strong analytical skills and the ability to synthesize complex input from multiple stakeholders into clear insights, risks, options, recommendations, and actions.* Experience in driving continuous improvement initiatives, defining pragmatic solutions, and embedding improved ways of working across teams and governance bodies.* Strong affinity for digital tools, process automation, and AI-enabled ways of working, combined with curiosity and the ability to translate technology potential into practical business impact.* Ability to identify high-value AI use cases, build and deploy AI agents or automated workflows, and integrate them into program-management processes.* Excellent stakeholder management skills, including the ability to challenge constructively, build trust, align diverse interests, and guide teams towards common objectives.* High degree of structure, ownership, reliability, and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic program environment.* Confident communication and facilitation skills, including the ability to moderate senior discussions and communicate clearly with both management and operational teams.* Advanced skills in Microsoft 365 and program-management tools such as Cloud ALM, Jira, Confluence, MS Project, PowerPoint, Excel, and Power Query; hands-on experience building solutions with integrated AI tools, Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, VBA, or comparable automation technologies is strongly preferred.* A recognized project-management qualification, such as PMI, PRINCE2, or SAP Activate, or comparable qualifications is a plus.* Fluent written and spoken English and German.* Based in the Bonn area or willing to relocate.   Your benefits* Amazing chance to be part of an international and cross-divisional and interdisciplinary Finance transformation project team of internal and external professionals and thought leaders* Unique opportunity to design cross-divisional Finance processes and establish a new ERP platform based on SAP S/4HANA on a green field and shape the future of Finance at DHL Group* Management driven by best practices and state-of the art solutions* Competitive compensation package, flexible working arrangements such as home office, company day care in Bonn and cooperation with “pme Familienservice”* Leasing of company bicycle or lease of (electric) company car.* Company pension plans and other forms of retirement provision* Opportunities for further education and development, such as training / mentoring programs, workshops, or support for professional growth.   Your contactFor further information on the post, Moritz Dentler will be happy to answer your questions, therefore please contact moritz.dentler@dhl.com.We are looking forward to your application.   CONNECTING PEOPLE. IMPROVING LIVES.

jobs.occupation: PhD position (m/f/d) in 4D Printing of Biodegradable Parts by Multi-Ink Binder Jetting 191/2026 (Ingenieur/in - Maschinenbau)
jobs.description: PhD position (m/f/d) in 4D Printing of Biodegradable Parts by Multi-Ink Binder Jetting (MultiMAM-101309938, DC-15)reference number 191/2026 is to be filled from 01.07.2027 or later.Pay grade: E13 TV-L Hours: 1.0 FTE (40 h/week)Contract type: limited to 36 monthsTechnical University Bergakademie Freiberg (TUBAF), Chair of Additive Manufacturing, invites applications for a fully funded PhD position within the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Doctoral Network MultiMAM (Multi-Material Additive Manufacturing).About MultiMAM ProjectMultiMAM (project no: 101309938) is a European Doctoral Network dedicated to accelerating the industrial adoption of Multi-Material Additive Manufacturing (MMAM), a key enabling technology for next-generation healthcare, aerospace, automotive, energy, electronics, and multifunctional products. Bringing together leading universities, research institutes, and industrial partners from 10 European countries, MultiMAM addresses critical scientific and technological challenges across the MMAM value chain through 15 pioneering doctoral projects focusing on materials, processes, and sustainability.As a Doctoral Candidate in MultiMAM, you will benefit from world-class scientific training, international collaboration, interdisciplinary supervision, and industry-focused secondments. Working within a highly diverse and interdisciplinary network, you will develop advanced technical expertise, practical research experience, and transferable skills while contributing to innovative solutions for sustainable digital manufacturing. Upon completion, you will be well positioned to become a future leader in MMAM, advanced manufacturing, and industrial innovation.About MultiMAM Doctoral Candidate Project 15 (DC15): Binder Jetting (BJT) is an AM technology that uses liquid binders to join powder particles. This PhD project aims to develop sustainable alternatives to conventional materials by upcycling biobased waste for BJT. A key focus is the integration of multiple functional inks to create components with locally tailored properties, such as embedded electrical wiring, magnetic sensing and responsive behaviour. Furthermore, 4D printing will be explored to enable components to change their properties in response to external stimuli, such as temperature or moisture. The overall goal is to combine sustainable materials, functional integration and circular economy principles to develop adaptive components with self-repairing capabilities and controlled end-of-life disintegration.Research focus and responsibilities:• Implement BJT using upcycled, bio-based materials from renewable resources.• Apply functional inks with electrical, magnetic and responsive properties for externally triggered and fixed-time biocompatible degradation. These inks will be optimized for BJT printing parameters.• Advance BJT through the integration of 2-4 distinct inks and produce printed parts with multiple ink functionalities.• Contribute to project deliverables, scientific publications, dissemination, network-wide events, and collaboration across the MultiMAM doctoral networkProposed Doctoral Supervision Panel:Prof. Henning Zeidler, TUBAF, Germany, Dr. Katja Heise, TUBAF, GermanyProf. Rocco Lupoi, Trinity College Dublin, IrelandIndustrial Secondment (4 months) at C-MARX GmbH, Chemnitz, Germany.Academic Secondment (2 months) at Trinity College Dublin, Ireland.QualificationsApplicants must have:- A two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree in in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Manufacturing Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or a closely related discipline.- Excellent academic achievements and strong analytical and problem-solving skills.- Excellent English communication skills, both written and oral.- Interest in interdisciplinary research and international collaboration, and interest in getting science applied in industriesApplicants with experience in one or more of the following topics will be preferred:- Additive manufacturing, mechanical engineering, or machine design.- Process engineering and biobased material knowledge- Knowledge of stimuli-responsive materials.- Experimental work involving mechanical, optical, or chemical setups.- CAD modelling, mechanical design, or design optimisation.- Programming, automation, machine learning or real-time process control.- Thermal management, experimental design, or statistical data analysis.Approval and Enrolment Enrolment for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval by the faculty board. The candidate will be enrolled in the PhD degree programme (“Promotionsstudium”) at TUBAF. AssessmentThe assessment of the applicants will be made by the Doctoral Supervision Panel led by Prof. Henning Zeidler. Eligibility Requirements: Applicants must: - not already hold a doctoral degree, and fulfil the requirements for enrolment in TUBAF’s PhD programme. - comply with Marie Curie Mobility Rule: At the recruitment date, applicants must not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in Germany for more than 12 months during the 36 months immediately before recruitmentFor the MultiMAM Doctoral Network project, a total of 15 PhD positions are available within the consortium. Applicants may apply for a maximum of two positions and must clearly indicate their first and second choices in each of the applications.Worrking Conditions, Benefits and Career DevelopmentThe successful candidate will be employed for 36 months as a research scientist within the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Doctoral Network project at TUBAF. Starting date is 1st of July, 2027 (or according to mutual agreement). The position is a full-time position.Working at the Resource University - regionally based and internationally networked. TU Bergakademie Freiberg is the university of resources and at the same time the oldest university of mining sciences in the world. Since its foundation in 1765, teaching and research have been oriented along the entire raw materials value chain. Today, this includes handling of natural raw materials from exploration, extraction, preparation and processing to recycling. The scientific fields represented at the university, which are reflected in the core fields of geo, materials, energy, environment and economics, are interlinked along the entire raw material value chain. The idea of sustainability, which was coined more than 300 years ago by Freiberg's chief miner Hans Carl von Carlowitz, was then as now the guiding principle in education and research. Think globally, act globally. - Access to world-class research infrastructure, six international training events across Europe and dual secondments.- Work at a family-friendly university with flexible working hours and Work in a committed and motivated team- Remuneration according to the Collective Agreement for the Public Service of the German Federal States (TV-L), depending on personal qualifications- Attractive additional benefits, e.g., capital-forming payments (VL), company pension scheme (VBL), health management, further training opportunities, “Job-Ticket”)- Further informationFurther information may be obtained fromProfessor Dr.-Ing. Henning Zeidler,Head of the Chair of Additive Manufacturing:henning.zeidler@imkf.tu-freiberg.de (https://mailto:henning.zeidler@imkf.tu-freiberg.de) , Phone +49 3731 39-3066.You can read more about the Chair of Additive Manufacturing at https://tu-freiberg.de/en/ (https://tu-freiberg.de/en/)  fakult4/imkf/chair-additive-manufacturing (https://tu-freiberg.de/en/fakult4/imkf/chair-additive-manufacturing.) . Your application:with quoting the reference number (191-E/2026) must be submitted no later than 05.02.2027 (23:59 CET) by email to: bewerbungen@tu-freiberg.de (https://mailto:bewerbungen@tu-freiberg.de)or by conventional mail: TU Bergakademie FreibergDezernat Personalangelegenheiten09596 Freiberg, GermanyPlease attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:- A motivation letter (cover letter) describing interest in the position and alignment with the     DC-15 project.- Curriculum Vitae (without photo and without information unrelated to professional qualifications).- Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale.- Documentation of English-language proficiency.- Contact details of two referees.- Relevant publications, portfolio, thesis work, project reports, or other supporting documentation, if available.You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. Severely disabled persons or persons of equal status (m/f/d) will be given preferential consideration if they have the same qualifications, performance, and abilities. Please include proof of this.  The TU Bergakademie Freiberg specifically promotes the proportion of women and expressly invites qualified.
